zh.name: 指令快捷语速查
zh.summary: 每页围绕一个短指令，用语法、作用和实际对话示例说明怎么调用。
zh.useWhen: 按命令语法查找，不是长篇创作提示词合集；不得把传言中的隐藏指令写成官方能力。
zh.instructions: 验证过的指令、使用环境、语法与实际输出
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Command Shortcut Cheat Sheet
en.summary: Create an Instagram reference carousel using the command shortcut cheat sheet structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the command shortcut cheat sheet format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
